acquisition_policy.final_response: select first terminal response including incomplete/truncated/refusal/invalid format; never retry content
acquisition_policy.long_server_delay: defer until server delay, never retry sooner
acquisition_policy.unknown_execution: retain full reserved maximum cost for each unknown attempt; retry only within explicit3-attempt cap

cost_scope: Token-accounted frozen standard list-price estimate in USD; output includes reasoning once, cache categories exclusive. Missing cache-write detail is explicitly flagged; conservative budget uses cache-write rates. All physical attempts and unknown bounds are separate from the first terminal response deployment estimate.
selection: First terminal provider response regardless of answer validity or correctness; no content-based retries.
